name: Hell's Gate National Park
blurb: Hell's Gate National Park in Kenya is located 50 miles outside of Nairobi and features a geothermal plant and rock climbing. Recent discussions mention its inclusion as a stage for the 2026 Safari Rally Kenya.

positive: Appreciated as an awesome place with great rocks

quotes.text: Hell's Gate is also a national park in Kenya which is great for rock climbing
